title: Florian Schuhbauer and Klaus Roehrig - Applying Activist Tactics to European Markets

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: One of our goals with this podcast is to get to know new markets, new situations.
reader_summary.overview: One of our goals with this podcast is to get to know new markets, new situations, and new investors who bring dynamism to all markets. A great example of this is the new generation of activist investors in Europe. Students of mine have heard me say for some time that Europe has been ripe for activism.

key_points.text: I believe that with structural changes in European capital markets, combined with the state of global markets.
My guests today, Florian Schuhbauer and Klaus Roehrig of Active Ownership Corporation (AOC).
They have been making headlines with groundbreaking campaigns and change they are bringing to European Capital Markets.
